title: Infrastructure graph
description: Draft contract for infrastructure descriptions referenced by the experiment manifest's infra_graph role (T004 / G4). Repo-level contract: lives outside Scale-up_Agent_Handoff/ per the handoff fence; promotion into the handoff schema set is an owner/ADR decision. Three dialects are recognized: an explicit node/link graph (handoff example style), an analytical free-parameter topology (experiments/topologies/*.yaml: ring, 2D torus, crossbar, recursive-doubling exchange), and the phase-collectives algorithm/transport config (experiments/topologies/phase_collectives8_free_params.yaml). The dialects are disjoint by their identity key (infra_id / topology_id / config_id). schema_version changes on every public change to this contract.

schema_version.description: Version of this document contract; optional because the existing experiment inputs predate it.

explicitGraph.description: Handoff example style: explicit graph of endpoints, switches, links, implementation profiles, and routes.

synthetic.description: True when the fabric is illustrative, not derived from a real deployment.

type.description: Observed node inventory; extending this set requires a schema_version bump.

dst.description: Node id at the other end.

implementation_profiles.description: Named implementation profiles referenced by nodes; values are free parameters unless anchored to a source.

kind.description: e.g. assumption, when the values are free parameters.

path.description: Node id sequence from src to dst, inclusive.

analyticalTopology.description: Repo analytical style: transport-agnostic L0 topology with explicit free parameters, as used by the analytical backends.

topology_id.description: Identity referenced by backends and phase-collectives configs, e.g. ring8_free_v1.

topology_class.description: Committed analytical topology classes; extending this set requires a schema_version bump. Extended with unidirectional_ring_with_serialization in contract 0.2.0 (second frontier F1: the L0.5 serialized ring, experiments/topologies/ring8_l05_free_params.yaml); extended with unidirectional_ring_tfc_window in contract 0.3.0 (flagship slice: the TFC credit-windowed ring executing UEC requirement UEC11-FC-R02, experiments/topologies/ring8_tfc_window_v1.yaml).

grid.description: Torus grid shape; present only for torus2d_ring_x_ring.

bytes_per_ns.description: Free parameter (e.g. A-L0-BW / A-L0T-BW): link bandwidth.

hop_latency_ns.description: Free parameter (e.g. A-L0-LAT / A-L0T-LAT): per-hop latency.

pair_latency_ns.description: Free parameter (e.g. A-L0X-LAT / A-L0D-LAT): uniform per-pair latency.

injection_bytes_per_ns.description: Free parameter (e.g. A-L0X-BW / A-L0D-BW): per-rank single-port injection bandwidth.

tfc.description: UEC TFC credit context per ring neighbor pair (topology_class unidirectional_ring_tfc_window, contract 0.3.0). Carries the parameters of requirement binding BIND-UEC11-FC-R02-L0TFC (src/essun/specir/bindings.py): window_bytes is granted credit (free deployment parameter, integral number of 256-byte credit units per UEC11-FC-R05), credit_return_latency_ns the free credit-loop return time.

window_bytes.description: Free parameter (A-TFC-W): granted TFC credit in bytes; must be an integral multiple of the 256-byte credit unit (UEC11-FC-R05).

credit_return_latency_ns.description: Free parameter (A-TFC-CR): credit-loop return latency; the UEC spec does not fix credit-return timing.

phaseCollectivesConfig.description: Repo analytical style: phase-collectives algorithm/transport pairing (P2 stage S4) — not a new fabric; ring-family phases reference a ring topology, halving/doubling phases a fully-connected exchange topology.

collective.description: First-class phase collectives; composed AllReduce is expressed via composition, not as an entry.

identity.description: Pre-registered closed-form identity the backend must reproduce.
